title: Kirby Problem 4.29
exact_target: Ask whether cyclic complement group forces topological or smooth unknotting, and whether a single minimum or a decomposition into two ribbon surfaces with unknotted cross-section forces unknotting in either category.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 2905 (KP-4.29). CC BY 4.0.
